_note: Closed normalization list. The tool refuses ids it does not implement; a pattern outside this list is a mismatch. Adding an entry needs user approval. N11 (yaml Mark object address, exact literal only) added by c33 (user-approved closed-list pattern). N13 (JSON object key order) is limited to the entries named in applies_to. N14 (wheel member comparison) applies to .whl files only.

normalizations.reason: repo absolute path prefix; each side substitutes its own root
ISO-8601 UTC timestamps and 10-digit epoch seconds
traceback reduced to its last non-empty line; exit code compared separately
mtime and permission bits are not compared
process-local address inside the literal <yaml.error.Mark object at 0x...>; the surrounding bytes stay strict

normalizations.replace: JSON object members sorted by key (layout and value text kept)
normalizations.reason: lite_metrics --json emits keys in set-iteration order, which differs per process hash seed

normalizations.replace: wheel (.whl) files compared by members: name, CRC-32, uncompressed size, attributes and date/time per central-directory entry; compressed bytes ignored
normalizations.reason: the Rust zip writer (miniz_oxide, raw DEFLATE level 1) and CPython zlib level 1 produce different compressed bytes for identical members; the user accepted a member-content comparison
